drivingQuestion: Does R' Shimon hold איסור חל על איסור?
outcomeNote: The difficulty is supported and answered in the next unit (keritot.sugya120).

segments.he: אָכַל אֶחָד אֶת הָרִאשׁוֹנָה כּוּ׳. אֲמַר לֵיהּ רָבָא לְרַב נַחְמָן: וּמִי אָמַר רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אִיסּוּר חָל אִיסּוּר?
segments.en: § The mishna further teaches with regard to the case of a piece of forbidden fat and a piece of forbidden fat that is notar, that if «one» person «ate the first» piece and another ate the second piece, Rabbi Shimon says: Each brings a sin offering for having eaten forbidden fat, and they bring an additional sin offering for the transgression of eating notar, with the stipulation that the offering is credited to the one who ate the notar. «Rava said to Rav Naḥman:» This indicates that the prohibition of notar takes effect despite the fact that the prohibition of forbidden fat already applied to this piece. «And did Rabbi Shimon say» that «a prohibition takes effect where» another «prohibition» already exists?
